title: Good quality, but incomplete
text: Good quality, but incomplete. This is a good quality set of dividers. However, there were 2 copies for Lamb, Beverages and Cheese and NO card for Chicken/Poultry! Who in the world has a recipe box with absolutely NO recipes involving chicken?! Good grief. Despite the quality of the set (it is thicker card stock than I had expected and the design is pleasing to the eye), I must deduct stars from my rating for the obvious issue of the exclusion of CHICKEN. I plan to make my own labels and fit them over the extra dividers in order to make use of the set. However, I should not have to do this. It should be a complete set from the start. Whoever created this and whoever gave the thumbs up to send it to the production line, should be fired for their lack of competence.
